launches.title: Zolvo: AI that runs commercial lending operations, from invoice verification to facility monitoring
launches.tagline: Zolvo connects a lender's bank accounts, loan management system and borrower conversations, so the team reviews exceptions instead of doing every step by hand.
launches.body:
**What's new**

When we first launched, Zolvo matched incoming payments and followed up on collections for commercial lenders. Today we're releasing a fully redesigned platform that covers the rest of the loan's life. Invoice verification, underwriting preparation, configurable workflows, cash posting and facility monitoring are now all in production, in one product.

**The problem**

Think about what happens with one invoice at a factoring company. It arrives by email. Someone checks the supporting documents and confirms the invoice with the debtor. Weeks later, someone else follows up for payment. When money lands in the bank account, a third person figures out which loan it belongs to. Each step uses information from a different place: bank records, the loan management system, documents, and email or WhatsApp threads. Most lenders connect those pieces by hand, so every new client means more headcount.

**How it works**

Zolvo connects to the lender's bank records, loan management system and communication channels, including email, WhatsApp and calls. With those connected, lenders can:

* **Verify invoices** against their supporting documents and debtor confirmations.
* **Prepare underwriting information** from documents the borrower has already sent, so credit teams start from an organized file.
* **Run collections** using strategies they set up themselves, and test different strategies over time to see which works best.
* **Post cash** by matching each incoming payment to the right loan. Matches can go to a person for review, or Zolvo can post them automatically if the lender sets it up that way.
* **Monitor the facility**, including covenant tracking across the portfolio.

The lender sets approval thresholds, so routine items go through and anything unusual goes to a person. Every decision Zolvo proposes can be traced back to the bank record, document or message it came from, so it's easy to check.

**Who it's for**

Factoring companies, asset-based lenders and other commercial lenders. Private credit funds use facility monitoring, covenant tracking and reporting to oversee the lending facilities they finance.

**See it in action**

<https://youtu.be/b4IZcelRtOg>

**Where Zolvo is running today**

Commercial lenders use Zolvo in production, and two more have become customers since our first launch. [Abaco Capital](https://zolvo.com/customers/abaco/) uses it for payment matching, collections and funder payment reporting. As Moises Hasbun, Co-founder and COO of Abaco Capital, put it: _"What used to take our team an entire day now happens in minutes with higher accuracy."_

**Team**

I'm Tony Montes, founder and CEO of Zolvo. I was a founding AI engineer at Domu (YC S24), where I built voice AI infrastructure that scaled to over 100,000 calls a day for enterprise fintech clients. Before that I did AI research, published at ACL and EMNLP, and worked on generative models at Cornell. I build Zolvo's product and infrastructure end to end.

**Asks**

1. **Do you know someone running operations or credit at a factoring company or ABL lender?** A warm intro means a lot to us.
2. **Do you know private credit teams that oversee lending facilities?** We'd love to show them facility monitoring.

[**Book a demo**](https://zolvo.com/contact/), and bring your own statements, invoices and exceptions so we can walk through your actual workflow.
